observations: Rendered actual candidate GLBs in the Babylon editor with the existing application lighting.
Changed sofa to navy and rotated to 15 degrees; camera radius, alpha and beta remained unchanged.
Independent brushed-metal color override #a57343, variant and rotation survived undo/redo and reload.
Book stack rested at 750 mm on the round marble dining table and survived reload.
A separate book stack used display-bookcase level-2 at its exact 740 mm usable shelf height.
Keyboard catalog selection created a visible unsaved lamp draft. Cancel preserved the 17-piece plan and undo count of two after reload.
Aquarium fish/tails and the instanced globe moved normally. Reduced-motion emulation stopped all fourteen observed motion nodes and zeroed both fire uniforms; emulation was restored.
Requested catalog preview images loaded successfully after refreshing the development cache; deferred lazy images were not counted as broken.
No browser console errors were observed. Two empty-position-buffer warnings occurred during initial empty-room setup.
The application Save screenshot action produced the attached unedited browser canvas capture.

performanceSample.scope: One local test machine and mixed room, not a cross-device guarantee or whole-catalog simultaneous load.

publication: This record is local evidence. Exact compressed delivery and final live Beta checks are separate release gates.
